details:
Q1. What should this issue target?
Choices:
A. One specific workflow or script — name it (for example: clarify, plan, implement, review_autofix, orchestrate_poll, validate) (RECOMMENDED)
B. Documentation or setup only — name the exact file(s) to update
C. A cross-workflow behavior — name the affected phases and the shared problem (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What concrete problem should be solved in that target area?
Choices:
A. A reproducible bug or failure — describe the current behavior, the expected behavior, and any issue/PR/run example (RECOMMENDED)
B. A reliability or operational problem — describe the noisy, slow, duplicate, or wasteful behavior and the desired improvement (RECOMMENDED)
C. A docs or usability gap — describe what information is missing, wrong, or confusing
Q3. What reference should planning use to confirm the work is done?
Choices:
A. An existing issue, PR, workflow run, or log snippet — include the number or a short quote (RECOMMENDED)
B. A plain-language before/after scenario — describe one concrete example and the expected result (RECOMMENDED)
C. Exact files or pages to update — list them if this is primarily documentation or setup work
